title: Japanese Curry over French Rice
description: A flavorful dish combining the spices of Japan with the elegance of French cuisine.
instructions: Heat the Japanese Curry in a pan over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of buttery to the pan and stir until melted.
Add 1 cup of fluffy rice to the pan and stir until coated in the curry mixture.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the rice is heated through.
